title: Cosmic Process Paradigm
definition: A conceptual framework that integrates the scientific description and the organic, process-oriented perspective of the universe, highlighting its growth and evolution.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of the universe as a cosmic garden that grows and changes over time. The Cosmic Process Paradigm is a way to describe this ongoing, natural growth using scientific and organic language.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Cosmic Process Paradigm is a concept that combines the structural descriptions of the Cosmic Web with the dynamic, organic metaphors of a blooming phenomenon. It offers a more comprehensive and nuanced understanding of the universe's evolution and development.
difficulty_levels.expert: The Cosmic Process Paradigm is a novel conceptual framework that synthesizes scientific and poetic terminology to provide a unified and more holistic understanding of the universe. It challenges existing terminology by emphasizing the universe as a living, growing system, rather than a static or human-invented structure. By doing so, it connects to the fields of complexity science, systems thinking, and the philosophy of becoming, offering a new lens through which to explore the cosmos.

extra_fields.insight: The Cosmic Process Paradigm is a unique and original concept that integrates scientific and poetic language to provide a new perspective on the universe's growth and evolution.
